settings.add_shell_choice: pre-registered in settings before any estimation draw
settings.pilot_ranking: decreasing true log L; ties by draw order (stable sort)
settings.radius_rule: enlarge * sqrt(d + 2) Mahalanobis radius of the sample covariance
settings.shell_sampler: rejection: uniform in B_i (cube via open_uniform; ellipse via isotropic direction and radius U^(1/d)), rejecting points outside the open cube or inside any later bound
settings.variance: sample variance with ddof = 1; delta method for Z_hat, P(a>0) and E[a^2]

cdf_discrepancy_a.note: Sup |weighted CDF - reference CDF| of a on 501 points in the display window. A sup statistic has no delta-method SE; compare its spread over independent seeds in seed_ensemble. Reference value from samplingdemo.reference (validation only; never used by the sampler).

cdf_discrepancy_b.note: Sup |weighted CDF - reference CDF| of b on 501 points in the display window. A sup statistic has no delta-method SE; compare its spread over independent seeds in seed_ensemble. Reference value from samplingdemo.reference (validation only; never used by the sampler).

e_a2.note: Weighted E[a^2]; delta-method SE 0.0092. Reference value from samplingdemo.reference (validation only; never used by the sampler).

e_a2_z_score.note: (E_hat - E_ref) / SE. Reference value from samplingdemo.reference (validation only; never used by the sampler).

log_z.note: Frozen-shell log Z_hat; delta-method SE 0.0606. Reference value from samplingdemo.reference (validation only; never used by the sampler).

log_z_before_add.note: log Z_hat before the add_samples event. Reference value from samplingdemo.reference (validation only; never used by the sampler).

p_positive.note: Weighted P(a>0); delta-method SE 0.0307. Reference value from samplingdemo.reference (validation only; never used by the sampler).

p_positive_z_score.note: (P_hat - P_ref) / SE. Reference value from samplingdemo.reference (validation only; never used by the sampler).

seed_ensemble.note: Reference recovery over 20 independent seeds with these settings (spec §14.3): z = (estimate - reference) / SE for z_hat, p_positive and e_a2, with within_2se counting |z| <= 2; cdf_a and cdf_b give each seed's sup CDF discrepancy, with n_ge_displayed counting seeds at least as large as the displayed run's; weight_ess gives each seed's Kish ESS, 1/sqrt of which is the heuristic scale of a sup discrepancy. The displayed run (seed 8202) is not among them. Reference value from samplingdemo.reference (validation only; never used by the sampler).

shell_posterior_mass_reference.note: Reference-only grid quadrature, not exact: posterior probability of each frozen shell by the midpoint rule on 2000^2 unit-square cells, each assigned wholly to the shell of its centre (ellipse edges become staircases). Halving the grid changes the masses by at most 1.7e-04, an indication of the discretization error, not a bound. Compare payload.shells.posterior_mass; never available to the sampler.

weight_ess.note: Kish 1/sum(wbar^2): a weight-concentration diagnostic, not an MCMC ESS.

z_score.note: (Z_hat - Z_ref) / SE with SE = sqrt(within + volume terms). Reference value from samplingdemo.reference (validation only; never used by the sampler).

label: Nautilus-inspired INS demonstration — frozen shells, fresh samples

notes.counters: likelihood_calls counts estimation draws only; pilot_likelihood_calls the pilot. geometric_candidates counts shell-sampling candidates up to each last acceptance; the M volume points are reported in volumes.M.
notes.no_threshold: Estimation draws are uniform in their shell; no likelihood threshold is applied to them (spec §8.3). log_l_rank_threshold is the pilot ranking cut used to select points for a bound, nothing more.
notes.overlaps: Bounds are not forced to nest. area_outside_previous_grid > 0 means B_k is not contained in B_(k-1); the set-difference shells stay disjoint and complete.
notes.pilot: Pilot evaluations only place the bounds (counted in pilot_likelihood_calls); they are not estimation samples and carry no weight.
notes.support: B_0 (unit square) keeps full prior support, so the estimator is consistent for any frozen bounds; a single ellipse cannot follow a curved ridge, which costs efficiency, not correctness.
notes.teaching_estimator: Frozen-design INS: bounds are fixed before any estimation draw and fresh draws are taken in each shell. Not a replay of adaptive Nautilus; see the nautilus traces for the actual package.
notes.volumes: Shell volumes come from an independent geometry-only stream, never from likelihood draws. SE components are reported separately (within-shell sampling and volume).

streams.draws: SeedSequence(seed).spawn(3)[2]: shell draws, initial allocation then add_samples
streams.geometry: SeedSequence(seed).spawn(3)[1]: M uniform points for shell volumes (geometry only)
